愿享美福，须要禁止舌头不出恶言，
嘴唇不说诡诈的话；
因為經上說：人若愛生命，
願享美福，須要禁止舌頭不出惡言，
嘴唇不說詭詐的話；
For
“He who would love life
and see good days
let him keep his tongue from evil
and his lips from speaking deceit.
因为经上说：人若爱生命，

For
“He who would love life
and see good days
let him keep his tongue from evil
and his lips from speaking deceit.
For it is said
Let the man who has a love of life
desiring to see good days
keep his tongue from evil and his lips from words of deceit:
也要离恶行善；寻求和睦，
一心追赶。
也要離惡行善；尋求和睦，
一心追趕。
Let him turn away from evil
and do good. Let him seek peace
and pursue it.
也要离恶行善；寻求和睦，
一心追赶。
也要離惡行善；尋求和睦，
一心追趕。
Let him turn away from evil
and do good. Let him seek peace
and pursue it.
And let him be turned from evil and do good; searching for peace and going after it with all his heart.
因为，主的眼看顾义人；
主的耳听他们的祈祷。惟有行恶的人，

主的耳聽他們的祈禱。惟有行惡的人，

For the eyes of the Lord are on the righteous
and his ears open to their prayer; but the face of the Lord is against those who do evil.”

neither be troubled.”
